learning_objective: 🎯 Let us explore the beautiful world of colours in nature and learn how to name them!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look up at the sky! It is a beautiful blue. Sometimes, after it rains, a magical rainbow appears with seven bright colours.
Look all around you! The grass is fresh and green. We see bright red apples on trees and yellow sunflowers smiling at the sun.
Every colour is special and makes our world look pretty. Yellow feels warm, and blue feels calm. What colour makes you the happiest?

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Rainbow Colour Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Walk around your house and find one toy or object for each colour of the rainbow. Tell your family the colour names in English!

quick_recap: ⭐ We see pretty colours everywhere in nature.
⭐ The sky is blue, the grass is green, and the sun is yellow.
⭐ A rainbow brings seven magical colours together.
